title: Geometry-Preserving Reduced-Order Modeling via Immersed Tensor Decomposition (ITD)
summary: Body-fitted finite-element methods deliver high-order accuracy but hinge on a clean, watertight, conforming mesh, a requirement that breaks down for the geometrically imperfect CAD assemblies, image-based volumetric data, and voxel-native designs that pervade biomedical engineering and additive manufacturing, where mesh generation has become the dominant cost of the analysis cycle. Immersed methods on regular background Cartesian grids sidestep body-fitted meshing, but classical implementations integrate over irregular cut subdomains, destroying the tensor-product structure that enables…
